preconditions.description: The input x must be a string.

postconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ' for c in x) or all(c == ' ' for c in x)
postconditions.description: The output string consists only of alphabetic characters or spaces (preserving original word boundaries).
The output string has the same length as the input string.

postconditions.expression: all(return_value.split()[i] == ''.join([x.split()[i][-1-j] if j < len(x.split()[i])//2 else x.split()[i][j-len(x.split()[i])//2] for j in range(len(x.split()[i]))]) for i in range(len(x.split())))
postconditions.description: For each word in the input string, the output word is formed by reversing the internal letters (excluding the middle letter for odd-length words) and moving them outward, while the middle letter (if odd-length) remains in place. For example, 'taxi' (length 4) becomes 'atix' and 'taxis' (length 5) becomes 'atxsi'.
